declared_inputs: resource package files registered through add_resource and add_gzip_resource
resource_surfaces.reference_surface: src/resources/CMakeLists.txt creates the resources-image LittleFS image, adds ESP, WUI, language, QOI, and other runtime files, and generates resources/revision_standard.hpp from the content hash.
resource_surfaces.rust_surface: Rust resource packaging must preserve the standard image member names, declared generator inputs, and revision-header identity before the runtime can consume bundled resources.
resource_surfaces.notes: This row records semantic package identity and source-path traceability only; physical media, firmware packaging, and cutover proof remain later evidence.

resource_surfaces.reference_surface: BOOTLOADER_UPDATE builds a resources-bootloader-image LittleFS image containing /bootloader.bin and generates a bootloader revision header plus required bootloader version header.
resource_surfaces.rust_surface: Rust bootloader-resource handling must preserve bootloader image membership, version parsing, and revision identity as a named resource compatibility surface.
resource_surfaces.notes: The row covers package metadata and resource identity; signing, product matrix artifact comparison, and hardware update behavior are not proven here.

resource_surfaces.reference_surface: When HAS_EMBEDDED_ESP32 is true, the resource image includes ESP32 uart_wifi, bootloader, and partition-table blobs and emits esp_parts.gen with flash offsets.
resource_surfaces.rust_surface: Rust ESP flashing/resource compatibility must preserve the ESP32 blob file names, runtime package paths, and declared flash-offset metadata source.
resource_surfaces.notes: The source blobs are tracked binary inputs; this row records their package paths and generator coverage, not ESP flashing runtime proof.

declared_inputs: esp8266 firmware and stub blob inputs
resource_surfaces.reference_surface: When the ESP flash task uses the ESP8266 path, the resource image includes uart_wifi, bootloader, partition-table, stub_text, and stub_data blobs and emits esp_parts.gen with flash and memory offsets.
resource_surfaces.rust_surface: Rust ESP8266 compatibility must keep the same runtime paths and declared offset metadata source for the retained ESP flashing flow.
resource_surfaces.notes: This is package identity evidence only; board module flashing behavior stays a later runtime proof item.

resource_surfaces.reference_surface: src/resources/CMakeLists.txt gzips and packages the tracked web favicon, index, JavaScript, and CSS assets into the standard resource image under /web.
resource_surfaces.rust_surface: Rust resource packaging must retain the WUI static asset paths and compression/package contract before WUI serving parity can be evaluated.
resource_surfaces.notes: This row does not claim HTTP API or browser behavior; it covers static asset source and package identity only.

resource_surfaces.reference_surface: QoiGenerator.cmake runs utils/qoi_packer.py over GUI PNG inputs to produce qoi.data and qoi_resources.gen, then packages qoi.data into the standard resource image.
resource_surfaces.rust_surface: Rust GUI/resource compatibility must preserve QOI generated-data identity, declared PNG inputs, and package path before image rendering parity is claimed.
resource_surfaces.notes: The row covers generated QOI resource identity; visual GUI behavior belongs to a later interface phase.

declared_inputs: full-chars.txt and related generated character sets
external-flash .mo files when TRANSLATIONS_IN_EXTFLASH is true
CPU-flash generated string tables when TRANSLATIONS_IN_EXTFLASH is false
resource_surfaces.reference_surface: Language resources are generated from .po files through lang.py and msgfmt, with FILE providers loading /internal/res/lang/*.mo and CPUFLASH providers including generated string-table headers.
resource_surfaces.rust_surface: Rust localization compatibility must preserve language identifiers, gettext hash behavior, generated string tables, and external language-pack paths.
resource_surfaces.notes: This is translation asset and lookup-surface coverage only; GUI text layout and workflow parity are out of this plan's scope.

declared_inputs: tracked generated font headers under src/gui/res/cc
resource_surfaces.reference_surface: Font assets are generated through the translation/font tooling and retained as tracked generated headers consumed by GUI resource code.
resource_surfaces.rust_surface: Rust GUI/resource compatibility must distinguish reviewed tracked font headers from build-generated outputs and keep font asset identity source-backed.
resource_surfaces.notes: This row records font/header ownership and source linkage; it intentionally leaves rendered UI proof to later GUI validation.

resource_surfaces.reference_surface: When HAS_MMU2 is enabled, the resource build cleans the MMU hex firmware, converts it to binary, configures the attached version header, and packages /mmu/fw.bin.
resource_surfaces.rust_surface: Rust MMU resource compatibility must preserve MMU firmware package path, source dependency identity, and attached-version metadata before auxiliary runtime parity is evaluated.
resource_surfaces.notes: The row covers packaged MMU firmware identity only; MMU protocol, flashing, and auxiliary-controller behavior remain later proof.

resource_surfaces.reference_surface: Resource content hashes are generated from LittleFS images, converted into revision headers, stored by InstalledRevision, and represented in BBF TLV metadata.
resource_surfaces.rust_surface: Rust resource compatibility must preserve revision header names, content-hash meaning, and BBF resource-hash metadata as explicit package contracts.
resource_surfaces.notes: This row names hash and revision identity without treating those hashes as new security controls or release approval evidence.

resource_surfaces.reference_surface: Runtime bootstrap compares BBF resource revisions, scans resource directories, copies files into the internal resource location, and records installed revisions.
resource_surfaces.rust_surface: Rust startup/resource compatibility must preserve bootstrap stage identity, revision comparison, copy semantics, and installed-revision state before resource upgrade behavior is considered compatible.
resource_surfaces.notes: The row is source-audit evidence for bootstrap identity; it does not prove media timing, GUI progress display, or physical update behavior.
